record.question: Which of the following is NOT a typical finding in Chronic Kidney Disease?
options: Persistent increase in serum sodium levels
Persistent rise in serum creatinine levels
record.explanation: Answer C: Persistent increase in serum sodium levels. Persistent hypernatremia is not a typical defining CKD finding; CKD is characterized by persistent kidney abnormalities, with eGFR/creatinine, urine and imaging findings varying by cause and stage. Reference: https://kdigo.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/KDIGO-2024-CKD-Guideline.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
